Background info:

  • So, about two months ago, I posted this sad lil thang about my baldiness and white hair.

  • I also asked people about white hair today; check out the responses. There are a lot of great suggestions I'll be investigating!

What I did and how.

Since about February, I started eating pumpkin seeds and having 2-3 cups of whole milk nearly daily. I dwindled off in between. In spite of that, I felt my hair grow stronger. I think the volume increased somewhat as well, but I'm not sure. There was significantly less hair loss. Ugh. It improved immensely.

I had been massaging coconut oil into my hair and rinsing it out the next day about twice a week.

Since about mid-May, I started applying this mixture to my scalp at least twice or thrice a week, leaving it on overnight, and washing it out the next morning (Selsun blue). I would massage it into my scalp quite vigorously, extra attention to the baldy spots.

  • 100 drops peppermint oil (hair growth)
  • 50 drops rosemary oil (hair growth)
  • 50 drops tea tree oil (dandruff)
  • mix into about 1/3 or 1/4 cup of a carrier oil, like sunflower, almond, or coconut (beware CO's low melting point and drainage issues. I haven't had problems, but heads up anyways).
  • for increased absorption, you can try warming up the oil before applying. feelsgoodman,2.
  • to avoid getting your pillows dirtay-dirtay, you can try putting a towel over your pillow or wearing a shower/nightie cap.

Results so far.

Either way, I'm overall very pleased. My hair feels SO MUCH thicker and stronger.
